rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to an HTTP response allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the __init__ method of the class being instantiated, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Data provided remotely is used in this external API without sanitization, which could be a security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If the id of an HTML attribute is malformed, its interpretation may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to the `__init__` method of a class will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.
